notes.title: 【Free Update】A New Story “Love•Distance”
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596563/7f0cc6003a1b118029a16471a22a69dc70966cc2.png
Please update the game and experience the new story.
Hope you will like it^_^

About the update:
1.The update is for free, you just need to update the game.

2.Before entering the 2nd Story, players have to clear at least 2 endings of the first story. We adjusted the saving file structure about this and try to use the Steam achievement data of player to fix their saving files.
But there is still a chance that some player already finished the first story can’t enter the 2nd directly.
So, we add a temporary backdoor: Pressing “c” and click on the 2nd story, you can play it without finishing the first one. However, we still highly recommend new player experience though the first story first.

3.For now, the new story only support the language below:
•Simplified Chinese
•Traditional Chinese
•English
•Japanese
The translations above is done by Ye@AkabaStudio. Other languages version will be done by lovely players. Sorry but please wait for a while.
4.We make some music for the 2nd story, if you like them or want to support us. Please get the Original Sound Track 2 (DLC).

We are already working on the 3rd story, hope we won’t take too long this time(/ω＼)

notes.title: 【Update】A New Story launch on 1st July
notes.notes:
Sorry for keep you guys waiting.
The new story is finally ready and it will be out on 1st July.

Serval things:
1. The new story will be FREE. Just update the game and you can play it.

2. I personally finish the translation for English and Japanese. I'm sorry but the following languages are NOT AVAILABLE for the new story now.
· Russian
· Italian
· Spanish

The translations above are done by lovely players. I will try to contact them to ask for help. But no schedule right now, sorry.

BTW, I already have the Portuguese and Polish version for the first story.
I will launch them after I get the second story as well, hopefully.

3. We created some new music for the new story, If you like it, you can get it from the OST2 (DLC).

OH, right!
I make a trialer for the new story, please check it out, it's on the store page.
